+1 to Marcus’s timeline. A couple of internal notes for the hands-on:
- Please reserve a continuous 90m block for the live prompt tuning — prefix caching and KV-cache warmup takes ~15–20m to stabilize for realistic latency numbers.
- For model selection: start with the 13B quantized variant; have a smaller 7B variant ready as fallback for throughput testing.
- Routing tiers: we should demo a primary low-latency route (SJC, quantized 13B) and an automated fallback to a cost-tier (7B) after a 200ms SLO breach.

If CloudMetrics prefers EU data residency for the demo, we can mirror everything in eu-central but that will bump the prep time by ~2h.

I’ve added these bullets into the agenda and dropped a provisional calendar slot (private link below). Marcus — when you confirm region and Ben’s RSVP I’ll finalize the load-test spec.

Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

-LaurA
